query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage a large operational workflow across Google Tasks, Xero, and Notion: update and move task records, create and revise invoices, record payments, consolidate Notion rules, and track operational follow-ups.
query_ground_truth.query: create and revise invoices in Xero
query_ground_truth.intent: Generate new invoices and modify existing ones within the Xero accounting platform.

request.query: create and revise invoices in Xero

results.use_case: create and revise invoices in Xero
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if multiple organisations or tenant unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Select the correct organisation using XERO_GET_CONNECTIONS (capture tenant_id for all later calls).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Find the billing party using XERO_GET_CONTACTS (handle multiple matches; capture ContactID).
[Optional (if no matching contact)] [Fallback]: Create the billing party using XERO_CREATE_CONTACT (store returned ContactID).

[Optional (if revenue/expense or tax codes uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch valid posting and tax codes using XERO_LIST_ACCOUNTS and XERO_LIST_TAX_RATES (choose ACTIVE codes appropriate for each line item).

[Required] [Step]: Create a draft billing document using XERO_CREATE_INVOICE (set Type/Status, include tenant_id, ContactID, currency, dates, reference, and LineItems with Quantity/UnitAmount/AccountCode/TaxType).
[Optional (for verification or sharing)] [Next Step]: Confirm totals and line details using XERO_GET_INVOICE (check Status, SubTotal/Total/TotalTax, and line breakdown).
[Optional (if adjustments are needed after creation)] [Next Step]: Modify allowed fields using XERO_POST_INVOICE_UPDATE (avoid duplicating by recreating).
known_pitfalls: [XERO_GET_CONNECTIONS] Using the wrong tenant_id writes into the wrong books; invoice creation can be blocked if there is no active connection.
[XERO_GET_CONTACTS] Searches can return close matches; rely on ContactID rather than display names to avoid mis-billing.
[XERO_LIST_ACCOUNTS] Responses can be very large (200+); pick an ACTIVE AccountCode that matches the line item type.
[XERO_CREATE_INVOICE] 400 ValidationException if ContactID is not in the selected tenant, dates are not YYYY-MM-DD, or AccountCode/TaxType is incompatible; recreating can produce extra drafts.
[XERO_CREATE_INVOICE] Providing a contact name instead of ContactID may implicitly create a new contact, increasing duplicate-contact risk.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Xero is a cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, providing invoicing, bank reconciliation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting in real time
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=xero. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="xero") to create a connection BEFORE executing any xero tools.

XERO_GET_CONTACTS.description: Tool to retrieve a list of contacts. Use when you need up-to-date contact information with filtering, paging, or incremental updates.

IDs.description: Comma-separated list of ContactIDs to filter by.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (requires pageSize). Iterate incrementing page until an empty result is returned to exhaust all records.

order.description: Sort by field, e.g. UpdatedDateUTC DESC.

where.description: OData-style filter for querying contacts. Optimized fields: Name, EmailAddress, AccountNumber, TaxNumber, ContactStatus, City, Country, IsCustomer, IsSupplier. Note: On high-volume accounts, some filters (e.g., IsCustomer, IsSupplier) may be rejected by Xero. If a filter fails on high-volume accounts, use searchTerm, page/pageSize pagination, or remove the where filter.

pageSize.description: Number of contacts per page (requires page).

ContactID.description: Xero ContactID. If provided, fetches a single contact at /Contacts/{ContactID}.

searchTerm.description: Case-insensitive search across Name, FirstName, LastName, ContactNumber, CompanyNumber, EmailAddress.

summaryOnly.description: Return a lightweight summary-only response when true.

If-Modified-Since.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss) to set as the If-Modified-Since header; returns only contacts created or modified since this timestamp.

XERO_CREATE_INVOICE.description: Create a new invoice in Xero. Supports both sales invoices (ACCREC) and bills (ACCPAY).

Type.description: Invoice type: ACCREC (accounts receivable/sales) or ACCPAY (accounts payable/bills).

ContactID.description: Xero Contact ID (UUID). At least one of contact_id or contact_name must be provided.

Tracking.description: Optional tracking categories; maximum 2 elements per line item.

AccountID.description: Associated account ID (UUID) related to line item.

TaxAmount.description: Auto-calculated tax percentage; can be overridden if incorrect.

LineAmount.description: Can provide when Quantity or UnitAmount omitted; reflects discounted price.

Description.description: Line item description. Must be at least 1 char long. Can create line item with just description.

DiscountAmount.description: Discount amount (ACCREC invoices and quotes only).

LineItems.description: List of line items for the invoice.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organization ID. If not provided, uses the first connected tenant. In multi-org setups, pass the same tenant_id consistently across all Xero tool calls.

ContactName.description: Contact name. At least one of contact_id or contact_name must be provided.

InvoiceNumber.description: Invoice number (auto-generated if not provided). WARNING: If this matches an existing invoice number, Xero will attempt to UPDATE that invoice instead of creating a new one. Omit this field to ensure a new invoice is created, or ensure the number is unique.

XERO_CREATE_CONTACT.description: Create a new contact in Xero. Contacts can be customers, suppliers, or both.

Name.description: Full name of the contact or organization.

LastName.description: Last name of the contact person.

FirstName.description: First name of the contact person.

tenant_id.description: Xero tenant/organization ID. If not provided, uses the first connected tenant.

phone_number.description: Primary phone number (will be added as DEFAULT phone type).

AccountNumber.description: Account reference number for the contact.

mobile_number.description: Mobile phone number (will be added as MOBILE phone type).

BankAccountDetails.description: Bank account details for the contact.
